title: Dexcom G6/Android 9 BT not pairing with transmitter
symptom: After switching to a Pixel 3 with Android 9, the phone's Bluetooth is not finding or pairing to the Dexcom transmitter. The source setup wizard message remains, and the user experiences missed signals and inability to communicate with dexcomPD.
fix: Upgrade to the latest nightly version of xDrip+ as suggested by a maintainer.
evidence_quote: Please both of you upgrade to the latest nightly to see if that helps:
